# Vendored dependency

`Pico-PIO-USB/` contains the build sources, license and upstream README from commit `b186e36bea0f3bcc2ee94ca1fa81e7f71281443a` of [Pico-PIO-USB](https://github.com/sekigon-gonnoc/Pico-PIO-USB).

The upstream Git database, examples, editor settings and CI configuration are omitted. The retained upstream files are unchanged. `pico-pio-usb.sha256.json` records the SHA-256 of each retained file, and the firmware build checks those hashes before compiling. `dependencies.lock.json` at the repository root records the pinned revision.

Pico SDK and the Arm toolchain are external prerequisites. Build scripts validate the configured SDK revision; they do not install, reset or update it. Additional reference notices are in `licenses/`.
